title: Strictness after strictification
statement: Let $C$ be a finite Boolean circuit with $n>0$ input vertices, gates in topological order, and a designated output vertex. Suppose each gate has distinct arguments, every NOT gate has one argument, and every gate has at most two arguments. Then the strictified circuit has distinct arguments at every gate, each NOT gate has exactly one argument and each other gate exactly two arguments, and every vertex other than its output is read by at least one gate.
hypotheses_covered: $C$ is a DAG circuit with $n$ inputs, gates in topological order, and a valid designated output
